name: Leticia
message:
I haven’t known you long or had much of an opportunity to get to know you but I would have to say that my favorite thing about you is your homemade jam!!!  I can also depend on getting a greeting card on almost all holidays! And the most important thing is that my husband adores you so you are pretty alright! 

Have a lovely 70th Aunt Julie. I hope it’s the best one yet!
